programme.title: Anh Does Vietnam
programme.desc: Comedian Anh Do returns to Vietnam to rediscover the land of his birth. He gives us a special insight into modern day Vietnam, from local family life to incredible culinary delights and the best adventures Vietnam has to offer. Tonight, Anh begins his journey in dynamic Ho Chi Minh City where he visits a Martial Arts Pagoda and submits to cupping therapy by a natural therapist. He stops for a beer at a busy roundabout restaurant before playing crazy food roulette, with one dish still squirming on the plate. Anh then travels by boat to the wartime battleground of Cu Chi, and visits an old friend who runs several schools for the Loreto-Vietnam Foundation. Finally, Anh heads north to the ancient city of Hoi An, and goes on a food tasting tour of Vietnam's top five dishes.

programme.title: Anh Does Vietnam
programme.desc: Tonight, Anh rents a motorcycle to explore central Vietnam and the Vietnamese fascination with Luck. Anh travels north to the capital of Hanoi where he samples produce from the Old Quarter's 36 specialist streets then enjoys the old-world French influence at the historic Metropole Hotel. Next he visits the mausoleum of Ho Chi Minh. Known as Uncle Ho to millions of Vietnamese, he is regarded as the father of modern, independent Vietnam. The spectacular scenery of the Red River Delta around Nin Binh is the setting for a hands-versus-feet rowing race on the river. Anh goes hunting for snails, a local delicacy, then cooks them up in the traditional way. Anh ends his journey in a north western mountain town of Sapa where Anh helps out at a local school and finishes the evening at a raucous party with Hmong tribal ladies.

At beekeeping, Shannon flirts with the beekeeper. After, Emily and Gina hash through their issues. At dinner, an emotional discussion leads to an unlikely apology. And the ladies have some late-night fun in the hot tub, where Brauwnyn reveals how she celebrates Sean's "monumental" birthdays.
